Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Procurement of Battery Operated JO Truck – 4 Wheeler 1. Scope of Supply The seller shall supply a new, unused, battery-operated four-wheeler JO Truck conforming to the technical specifications mentioned in the bid. The vehicle shall be complete with battery, charger, accessories and al l standard equipment required for satisfactory operation. 2. Technical Specifications The offered vehicle shall meet the following minimum technical requirements: Ser Technical Parameter Required Specification 1 Vehicle Type Battery Operated 4-Wheeler Heavy-Duty Truck 2 Seating Capacity 2–4 Seater (Front) 3 Luggage/Cargo Carrier 800 kg to 01 Ton Capacity 4 Driving Range 100–200 KM 5 Maximum Speed 20–35 KM/H 6 Loading Capacity 800 kg to 01 Ton 7 Battery Lithium-ion, 100 AH 8 Battery Charger 60 V, 20 AH 9 Motor 60 V Li Motor BLDC, 4.0 KW 10 Tyres MRF, 145/70-12 11 Braking System Front Disc Brake and Rear Drum Brake 12 Carrier Dimensions Length: 3657.6 mm, Height: 828.8 mm, Width: 1117.6 mm 13 Ground Clearance 220 mm 14 Turning Radius 5000 mm 15 Lighting System Front, Rear and Reverse Lights – LED 16 Steering Manual Steering

3. Technical Compliance Documents The bidder shall upload the manufacturer's technical catalogue/brochure of the offered vehicle. The bidder shall submit a point-wise technical compliance statement against all specifications ment ioned in the bid. The offered make and model shall be clearly indicated. Any deviation from the stipulated technical specifications shall be clearly highlighted. Non-submission of the required documents or submission of incomplete technical details may result in rejection of the bid. 4. OEM Authorisation The bidder shall submit valid OEM authorisation, wherever applicable, authorising the bidder to participate in the tender and supply the offered vehicle. 5. Vehicle Inspection and Demonstration The buyer reserves the right to inspect the offered vehicle before acceptance. The seller shall arrange a demonstration of the offered vehicle, if required by the buyer. The vehicle shall be checked for compliance with the stipulated technical specifications, load-carryi ng capacity, battery performance, driving range, braking system and other essential parameters. Any vehicle found technically non-compliant shall be liable for rejection. 6. Delivery and Installation The vehicle shall be delivered to the consignee location mentioned in the GeM contract. The seller shall ensure that the vehicle is delivered in fully assembled and operational condition. The battery and charger shall be supplied along with the vehicle. The seller shall provide necessary operating instructions and user manuals. 7. Warranty The seller shall provide a minimum warranty of one year from the date of successful delivery and acceptan ce of the vehicle, covering manufacturing defects and workmanship. Battery and motor warranty shall be as per OEM standard warranty, details of which shall be submitted along with the bid.. 8. General Conditions The vehicle shall be brand new and not refurbished or used. All supplied components shall be genuine and of OEM standard. The seller shall be responsible for safe transportation and delivery of the vehicle. Any damage noticed during delivery shall be rectified or replaced by the seller without additional co st to the buyer. The buyer reserves the right to reject any item not conforming to the specifications and ATC conditi ons. 9. Acceptance of ATC All bidders shall carefully read and comply with the Buyer Added ATC and technical specifications before s ubmission of their bids. Submission of the bid shall imply acceptance of all stipulated terms and conditions.
